send.title: Send DigiByte
receive.title: Receive DigiByte
contacts.title: Contacts

identity.title: Digi-ID
identity.addrWarning.title: Not for receiving payments
identity.addrWarning.body: This is an identity address, used only to sign in to this site. The wallet does not watch it, so any funds sent here will not show in your balance. Never use it to receive payments.
identity.addrWarning.link: Sent funds here by mistake? Recover them
identity.recover.title: Recover funds
identity.recover.intro: A Digi-ID address is for signing in, and the wallet does not watch it. If someone sent DGB to one by mistake, the funds are not lost. Check your sites here, then move the funds into your wallet.
identity.recover.locked: Unlock your wallet to check for funds. Nothing is looked up while it is locked.
identity.recover.unsupported: Recovering funds needs a wallet with a seed phrase. This wallet is watch-only or uses a single key, so it has no Digi-ID addresses.
identity.recover.siteInvalid: That is not a website name. Enter a name like example.com.
identity.recover.historyEmpty: Your login history is empty, for example after restoring from a seed phrase. Add the websites you used to sign in.
identity.recover.pending: Pending, can be swept once confirmed
identity.recover.allFailed: Could not check any site. Check your connection and try again.
identity.recover.error.generic: Something went wrong. Nothing was sent.
identity.recover.review.title: Review the sweep
identity.recover.review.intro: Each site is swept in its own transaction, to its own new address in your wallet, so your sites are not linked to each other.
identity.recover.review.remaining: {0} more can be swept after these confirm.
identity.recover.review.empty: Nothing can be swept from the selected sites right now.
identity.recover.status.title: Your sweeps
settings.title: Settings
remittance.title: Send Money
remittance.description: Send DGB to anyone by username or phone number — no address needed.
create.phrase_warning: Write these 24 words down and store them safely. They are the only way to recover your wallet.
create.pin_hint: Choose a PIN to unlock your wallet every time you open the app.
create.pin_limitation: A 6-digit PIN can be guessed offline by someone who copies this browser's data. Keep your device locked and protected, and keep your recovery phrase backed up.
dd.title: DigiDollar
dd.unsupported: DigiDollar requires a wallet created from a recovery phrase
dd.notActive: DigiDollar is not active on this network yet
dd.unavailable.state: DigiDollar is temporarily unavailable. Cannot reach the network.
dd.cached.banner: Cannot reach the network. Showing your last known balance, as of {0}.
dd.receive.title: Receive DigiDollar
dd.receive.hint: Share this address to receive DigiDollar. It works with DigiDollar only, not DGB.
dd.send.title: Send DigiDollar
dd.send.custody: You sign this on your device with keys from your recovery phrase. DigiByte Wallet never holds your keys or your funds.
dd.send.err.notDdAddress: Enter a valid DigiDollar address. DGB addresses cannot receive DigiDollar.
dd.send.err.wrongNetwork: This address belongs to a different network than this wallet.
dd.send.err.insufficientDd: That is more than your available DigiDollar balance.
dd.send.err.changeBelowMin: The remainder would be under $1.00. Send your full balance ({0}) or leave at least $1.00.
dd.send.err.changeAboveMax: The remainder would be over $100,000.00. Send a larger amount.
dd.send.err.insufficientDgbFee: Not enough DGB to pay the network fee. Add DGB and try again.
dd.send.err.slowDown: You are sending too fast. Wait a minute and try again.
dd.send.err.offline: Cannot reach the network. Try again when you are back online.
dd.send.err.amountFormat: Enter an amount in dollars with up to two decimals.
dd.send.failed: Your DigiDollar send of {0} to {1} did not go through. Your funds were not spent.
dd.confirm.title: Confirm DigiDollar send
dd.confirm.own: This is one of your own addresses.
dd.confirm.custody: This is signed on your device. DigiByte Wallet cannot move your funds for you.
dd.confirm.warn.oracleStale: The DGB price from the oracle is out of date.
dd.confirm.warn.err: DigiDollar is in its emergency redemption state.
dd.confirm.warn.volatility: DigiDollar is in a price-volatility protection state.
dd.confirm.warn.priceUnavailable: No DGB price is available right now.
dd.banner.err: DigiDollar is in its emergency redemption state. You can still receive and send.
dd.banner.volatility: DigiDollar is in a price-volatility protection state. You can still receive and send.
dd.banner.priceUnavailable: No DGB price is available right now. DigiDollar still works.
dd.banner.oracleStale: The DGB price is out of date (updated {0} ago). DigiDollar still works.
dd.banner.nodeLag: The connection is behind the network, so balances may be out of date.
dd.oracle.title: DGB price oracle
dd.oracle.body.live: The price is fresh and DigiDollar is operating normally.
dd.oracle.body.stale: The price has not been updated for a while. DigiDollar still works.
dd.oracle.body.protected: A protection state is active on the network. You can still receive and send.
dd.oracle.body.unavailable: The price oracle cannot be reached right now. DigiDollar still works.
dd.oracle.analytics.hint: Price published on chain by the DigiDollar oracle network, in USD per DGB.
dd.history.title: Activity
dd.send.err.scanInvalid: That QR code is not a DigiDollar address.
dd.home.dgbValue: Your DGB is worth {0} at the oracle price
upgrade.notice.title: Your wallet now has stronger protection
upgrade.notice.body: We upgraded how this wallet is protected on this device. Nothing changes for you: use the same PIN. For 7 days we keep the previous copy so you can go back to an older version of the app; until it is removed, someone who copies this browser's data could still guess your PIN against that older, weaker copy.
create.credential.choose: Choose how to protect your wallet
create.passphrase.title: Set Your Passphrase
create.passphrase.recommended: A passphrase is recommended if you will hold a larger amount: it is far harder to guess than a 6-digit PIN.
create.passphrase.explain: Choose a passphrase of at least 12 characters, such as several unrelated words. It protects this wallet on this device and is much harder to guess than a PIN.
create.passphrase.unrecoverable: Nobody can reset a forgotten passphrase, including us. If you forget it, you can only get back in with your recovery phrase, so keep that safe.
create.passphrase.label: Passphrase
create.passphrase.mismatch: The two passphrases don't match. Try again.
passphrase.reject.too_short: Too short. Use at least 12 characters, for example several unrelated words.
passphrase.reject.too_long: Too long. Use at most 256 characters.
passphrase.reject.common: Not accepted: this is a very common passphrase. Choose something only you would think of.
passphrase.reject.repeated: Not accepted: it just repeats the same characters. Mix in different words.
passphrase.reject.sequential: Not accepted: it is a simple sequence like abcdef or 123456. Choose something less predictable.
protection.title: Wallet protection
protection.nudge: Your PIN protects your wallet on this device. For extra peace of mind, you can switch to a passphrase: a few words of your choosing that are even harder to guess.
protection.done: Protection updated. Use the new PIN or passphrase from now on.
protection.wrong_current: That is not the current PIN or passphrase.
protection.pin_invalid: A PIN must be exactly 6 digits.
protection.failed: Could not change the protection. Nothing was changed.
